import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
R,G,B=im[...,0].astype(int),im[...,1].astype(int),im[...,2].astype(int)
# classify
H,W=R.shape
def cls(r,g,b):
    if r>150 and g>120 and b<120 and r-b>60: return 'Y'
    lum=(r+g+b)/3
    if lum<45: return '#'  # very dark
    if lum<85: return '+'
    if lum>175: return '.'
    return '-'
# downsample 2x2 -> 128x72, then print every other to fit ~64x36
for y in range(0,H,2):
    line=''
    for x in range(0,W,2):
        block=im[y:y+2,x:x+2].reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
        line+=cls(*block)
    print(line)
